system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: In near-total darkness, <Subject:car> sits facing the lens, its low body almost indistinguishable from the black around it. Only a faint edge of roof and hood separates the shape from the void; the <Subject:darkness> presses close on every side, with no horizon or background detail visible. The car is motionless at first, then begins to roll forward. Its headlights thicken into two bright cones that push the shadow back from the ground immediately ahead, revealing a narrow strip of textured surface and the first sense of distance between the vehicle and the space it is leaving. The movement is steady and deliberate, the car growing slightly more legible as light reaches its front surfaces while the surrounding black remains otherwise unbroken. The beams do not yet reach far; they carve a small, advancing pocket of visibility out of the dark, and the car's forward line stays fixed as it starts to come clear.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: In the blackness, <Subject:car> remains a still, barely separable silhouette facing the lens.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine note rises from near silence, soft and steady under the dark.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: The <Subject:car> begins to roll forward; its headlights thicken into two cones and push the shadow back from the ground ahead.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The <Subject:car> continues pulling forward, its body and forward surfaces catching more of the light as it leaves the deepest shadow behind. The twin headlight beams now stretch farther across the ground, exposing a widening path of rough, pale-edged surface while the car gathers pace toward the lens side of frame. Its silhouette becomes fully readable: a dark, solid form with bright lamps leading the advance, the contrast between lit metal and surrounding black sharpening with each meter. The engine tone deepens as the car accelerates, and the last pockets of shadow slide away from the front of the vehicle. The car closes distance without turning, holding its forward line as the illuminated ground and the car's own moving shape dominate the frame. Light spills across the front corners and along the lower body, but the background remains a clean, unbroken black beyond the reach of the lamps.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The <Subject:car> continues pulling forward, clearing the deepest shadow as its body catches more light.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The engine tone deepens as the car accelerates, remaining low and continuous.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: The twin headlight beams stretch farther across the ground, revealing a widening path while the car grows more fully readable.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A low engine note rises from near silence, then deepens into a steady mechanical tone as the car accelerates. No dialogue, voices, or added music.
